Then, during covid I picked up coding again, learned react, typescript, etc - even built a rudimentary site - and then came the chatgpt moment, followed by Claude etc.

So, as a side project, considering that I had spent 20 years in finance and M&A I started building Ekselio, loveable for finance workflows.
